title: Proof Record
description: One executed proof command, recorded by the role that executed it [VPX-003]. Stored in MT JSON validation.proof_records[] for per-MT proof and in the packet VALIDATION_REPORTS typed block for WP-level proof. Validator verdicts may cite only proof records whose executor_role is the validator's own role [VPX-001][VPX-004]; implementer records are triage input only [VPX-002].

proof_id.description: Stable id cited by verdict receipts, e.g. PR-WP-1-Example-v1-MT-003-001.

cwd.description: Working directory, repo-relative ("." for repo root). Never absolute.

commit.description: Commit the proof ran at; must equal the MT/packet validate_at_commit or reviewed range head for verdict use.

tree_clean.description: git status clean for the product paths in scope at execution time. false blocks PASS [VPX-001].

executor_role.description: Role whose governed session executed the command.

executor_session.description: Governed session id of the executor.

target_dir.description: Artifact target, relative to HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT, e.g. WP-1-Example-v1/MT-003/wp-validator/target. Validator records must sit below WP-{ID}/<validator-owner>/ [VPX-001].

result_line.description: Final result line as emitted by the tool (e.g. `test result: ok. 12 passed; 0 failed`).

env_knobs.description: Environment variables that affect the proof (e.g. CARGO_TARGET_DIR, RUST_LOG, HANDSHAKE_* knobs).

covers.description: MT ids (MT-NNN) or packet acceptance-row ids this execution proves.
